# BIS HANOI TUITION FEES
## OUR SCHOOL FEES
### Application Stage
We charge a non-refundable Application Fee of 4,500,000 VND per child, which is payable when you submit your online form and supporting documents.
This covers the cost of carrying out your child’s entrance assessment.
### Enrolment Stage
A non-refundable Registration Fee of VND 23,600,000 for the Foundation Stage or VND 70,800,000 for Primary and Secondary is payable when the offer of a school place is accepted by parents.
The Registration Fee is paid only once and guarantees the place for the student.
The acceptance of a school place is not confirmed until the Registration Fee has been paid.
We also charge a refundable Security Deposit of 23,600,000 VND, which we’ll return to you when your child leaves the school, provided you’ve given us 90 days’ written notice.

It’s important we’re able to meet your child’s learning needs and offer the right combination of support and challenge.

# ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
### BIS HANOI'S ADMISSIONS REQUIREMENTS
We offer places all year round to children aged from 2 to 18, and we’re open to students from all backgrounds and nationalities.
...
## APPLICATION AND SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS
After filling in an enquiry form and taking a tour of our campus – either in person or online – we’ll ask you to complete your child’s online application.
You'll also need to provide a selection of supporting documents.
Please submit:
- A signed copy of our Admissions Terms and Conditions.
- Your child’s most recent school records in English (translated where applicable).
- Learning support assessment documents (if applicable).
- Learning Support assessment documentation (where applicable).
- A digital, passport-style photo of your child.
- A copy of your child’s passport or birth certificate.
- Your child’s medical and immunisation records.
- A physical evaluation, signed by a doctor.
...
## ASSESSMENT AND INTERVIEW
Once we’ve received your form and documents, we’ll invite your child to an assessment and interview with our Head of Primary or Secondary.
The type of assessment will depend on your child’s age.
If your family is based overseas or can’t make it to our school, your child can sit their assessment online.
- Early years students (Foundation 1-3): class observation.
- Year 1 students: English as an Additional Language (EAL) test, class observation, and an interview with our Head of EYFS.
- Year 2 students: CAT 4 (Cognitive Ability Test), English as an Additional Language (EAL) test, class observation, and an interview with our Head of Primary.
- Year 3-6 students: writing test, CAT computer test, an English as an Additional Language (EAL), and an interview with our Head of Primary.
- Year 7-12 students: writing test, Cambridge Insight test, an English as an Additional Language (EAL) assessment, and an interview with our Head of Secondary.
...
### OFFERING YOUR CHILD A PLACE
Following your child’s assessment, you’ll receive a letter formally offering them a place.
This will include the date of their first day, along with a copy of our terms and conditions.
You’ll have a two-week window to accept this offer, with a non-refundable registration fee guaranteeing your child’s place in our school community.

content.text:
## Admissions process

BIS Hanoi accepts applications year-round for children aged **2–18**. The usual steps are:

1. **Enquire** through the school’s online form; the admissions team says it aims to respond within one working day.
2. **Arrange a campus tour**, in person or virtually.
3. **Submit the online application** and supporting documents. These typically include recent school records in English, a passport or birth certificate, a photo, medical and immunisation records, signed terms and conditions, and any relevant learning-support assessments.
4. **Complete an age-appropriate assessment and interview.** The format varies by year group; students abroad may be assessed online.
5. **Receive an offer**, if a place is available and the assessment is successful. Families generally have **two weeks** to accept and pay the registration fee to secure the place.

## Tuition and other fees

For the **2026–27 academic year**, the published annual tuition figures are:

| Year group | Annual tuition |
|---|---:|
| Foundation 1, half-day | VND 253.6 million |
| Foundation 1, full-day | VND 343.1 million |
| Foundation 2 | VND 360.9 million |
| Foundation 3 | VND 510.8 million |
| Year 1 | VND 657.6 million |
| Years 2–4 | VND 715.5 million |
| Years 5–6 | VND 734.6 million |
| Years 7–9 | VND 846.8 million |
| Years 10–11 | VND 893.2 million |
| Years 12–13 | VND 970.2 million |

Additional charges include a **non-refundable VND 4.5 million application fee**, payable with the application; a **non-refundable registration fee** of VND 23.6 million for Foundation or VND 70.8 million for Primary and Secondary; and a **refundable VND 23.6 million security deposit**. Tuition is paid in advance by term. Check the school’s official fee schedule for what tuition covers and the latest payment dates.

**Sources:** [BIS Hanoi admissions](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/admissions), [official fee information and schedule](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/admissions/tuition-fees).
